description:
🚀 Layl !

Our goal is to create an interactive, educational space simulation where young aspiring astronauts can experience real-world mission challenges, make critical decisions, and learn what it takes to survive and succeed in space.

Our team brings interests and experience in software development, cybersecurity, medical field, and creative problem-solving. We want to combine technology, science, gamification to make space exploration exciting to different types of learners.
summary: Layl is an interactive space game to transform children's curiosity about space into reality. children interested in space exploration lack hands-on pathways to pursue it, LAYL immerses juniors in missions that build essential skills besides the main mission of growing pharmaceuticals using microgravity.
details: The simulation builds the fundamental traits every astronaut needs: multitasking, working under pressure, as well as attending to crew mates. In order to bridge the gap in the space industry where it makes up only 0.02% of the global workforce in comparison to its vast contributions, Juniors need a tool that can support them in their initial steps towards space. The initial development of the project was built on a local website, using Java script, HTML, and CSS alongside the assistance of CHATGPT in minor adjustments and adaptations. Throughout the 48hours period our project includes: An achievement tab where juniors keep track of their progress, a characters tab where players can unlock items and characters which makes the experience more enjoyable and fun, main quests of growing pharmaceuticals via microgravity and refilling oxygen tanks at the appropriate time. When players enter the game, they are met with four stations consisting of: Medical bay where they are expected to tend to crew mates, Oxygen tank refilling, Crystal growing station and finally a lab to process the crops.
